note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs/B-L records with HS codes and B-L numbers (73063090, 84559000, 85372000) to Saudi Arabia and USA, latest 2026-02-27; the visible rows are pipes/pipe-mill equipment, not HS 720421. Declared HS 720421 (flat-rolled stainless steel >=600mm) does not match the observed export lines; per project rules this is not a rejection ground — company stays in the base, actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes (73063090 ERW line pipe, 84559000 parts of metal rolling mills, 85372000 HT panels) and verdict is accepted_hs_corrected. Note also that several visible consignees are group affiliates (Welspun Pipes Company LLC, Dammam; Welspun Tubular LLC, USA), i.e. intra-group offtake rather than only third-party sales.
